title: Analytic: Pockels phase shift vs voltage and V_pi (electrostatics + FDFD H_z)
description:
A y-periodic 8.0 x 0.2 um strip, eps_r = n0^2 everywhere (n0 = 2.138, n_e of lithium niobate), contains a 4 um crystal slab (x = 2..6 um, crystal z along model y: r_yy = r33 = 31e-12, r_xx = r13 = 10e-12 m/V, eps_dc 43 / eps_dc_yy 28; cladding eps_dc 3.9). Electrostatics: V0 on y_hi, 0 V on y_lo, x faces insulated, so E_y = -V0 / d exactly in every cell (d = Ly). electrostatics_em_pockels (field_component y) gives dn_ii = -1/2 n0^3 r_ii E_y; em_fdfd_hz launches the 1.55 um plane-wave mode at x_src, whose tangential E_y sees eps_yy. Stationary study, sweep V0 = 0..240 V.
Analytic: dn_yy = n0^3 r33 V0 / (2 d); dphi = -L [k_num(n0 + dn_yy) - k_num(n0)], k_num(n) = (2 / dx) asin(n k0 dx / 2) (the discrete plane-wave k); first order -pi V0 / V_pi with V_pi = lambda d / (n0^3 r33 L) = 256 V (dphi = -2.95 rad at 240 V, kept inside (-pi, pi]).
Sweep tab: dphi (phase_positive of 'down' minus the cold discrete phase -k_num(n0) (x_down - x_src), wrapped) with its dashed reference and the dashed first-order line; phi_up (upstream monitor, unperturbed glass: reference 0); E_y_mean (-V0 / d); dn_yy and dn_xx (crystal mean of sqrt(eps) - n0).
Line profile tab: eps_yy_profile (em.eps_yy along x: (n0 + dn_yy)^2 in the crystal, n0^2 outside) and V_profile (electrostatics.V across y: V0 y / d), at the last sweep value.
Expected: dphi ~1e-3 relative (Fabry-Perot ripple of the slab ends, (dn / 2 n)^2 ~2e-3 at 240 V), phi_up ~1e-3 rad absolute, E_y and dn ~1e-5 (exact discrete solution in float32).

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: voltage on y_hi [V] (y_lo at 0 V; sweep 0..240 V)

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the FDFD solve

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber k0 [1/m]

parameters.name: n0
parameters.description: index of every cell before the Pockels change (n_e of lithium niobate)

parameters.name: r33
parameters.description: Pockels coefficient on the component along the field (r_yy) [m/V]

parameters.name: r13
parameters.description: Pockels coefficient on the component across it (r_xx) [m/V]

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x (CPML for the EM, insulated for the electrostatics)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: strip height d between the plates (periodic for the EM)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: x_xtal0
parameters.description: crystal slab start (cell edge)

parameters.name: x_xtal1
parameters.description: crystal slab end (cell edge)

parameters.name: L_xtal
parameters.description: crystal length L

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: mode source line (cell 50 centre)

parameters.name: x_up
parameters.description: upstream mode monitor (cell 75 centre)

parameters.name: x_down
parameters.description: downstream mode monitor (cell 325 centre)

parameters.name: E_y_ref
parameters.description: applied field E_y = -grad V [V/m]

parameters.name: dn_yy_ref
parameters.description: index change of eps_yy in the crystal

parameters.name: dn_xx_ref
parameters.description: index change of eps_xx in the crystal

parameters.name: k_num0
parameters.description: discrete FDFD wavenumber in the unperturbed glass [1/m]

parameters.name: k_num_xtal
parameters.description: discrete wavenumber in the biased crystal [1/m]

parameters.name: dphi_ref
parameters.description: analytic Pockels phase shift [rad]

parameters.name: phi_up_cold
parameters.description: cold phase of the upstream monitor [rad]

parameters.name: phi_down_cold
parameters.description: cold phase of the downstream monitor [rad]

parameters.name: V_pi
parameters.description: half-wave voltage (first order) [V]

analytic_curves.name: eps_yy_profile
analytic_curves.expression: where(x > x_xtal0, where(x < x_xtal1, (n0 + dn_yy_ref)**2, n0**2), n0**2)
